Agriculture/allied Degree; Knowledge of computer with MS-CIT. Age limit: Maximum 38 years. Pay: *Fixed pay Rs. 26000 per month (upto 31st March, 2027 only).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the project subject to satisfactory performance. Pay is up to 31 March 2027 only. Selected candidates must join physically within seven days of the order, failing which the order is cancelled. One-month prior notice required before leaving, failing which one month pay or pay for the shortfall will not be drawn. Statement accepting terms and conditions on Rs. 100/- bond paper to be submitted after appointment. Research Associate gets no regular leave; attendance kept in an attendance register.

content_sections.heading: How Will Dr. PDKV Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Personal interview Personal interview before Head, Department of Entomology, PGI, Dr. PDKV, Akola. Original certificates are verified by the concerned officer. If there are a large number of candidates, the interview may continue on the next day.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of birth proof Educational qualifications, SSC and above Reprints of research papers published (if any) Experience certificate (if any) No objection certificate of the employer, if employed Originals plus one set of attested photocopies

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the application proforma uploaded on the University website www.pdkv.ac.in (also printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice). Fill in the proforma for the post and attach all necessary true copies duly attested. Report for personal interview on 06-11-2026 at 11.00 AM at the chamber of Head, Department of Entomology, PGI, Dr. PDKV, Akola. Bring original testimonials and one set of Xerox copies; no candidate is allowed after 12.00 pm.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Separate interview call letters will not be sent. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Appointment gives no claim to any University post; Research Associate has no right to regular appointment or absorption. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. The PI & Head, Department of Entomology, reserves the right to cancel/postpone the interview. The decision of the PI of the CROPSAP Project is final.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 6 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Research Associate (Entomology/Plant Pathology), 2 Assistant Research Associate.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 6 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Chamber of Head, Department of Entomology, PGI, Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 38 years. Relaxation: SC, ST, DT, NT, OBC As per rule.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: *Rs. 61000 + HRA per month For M.Sc. *Rs. 67000 + HRA per month For Ph.D. (upto 31st March, 2027 only) for Research Associate (Entomology/Plant Pathology), *Fixed pay Rs. 26000 per month (upto 31st March, 2027 only) for Assistant Research Associate.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Research Associate: M.Sc. or Ph.D. Agril. Entomology/Pl. Pathology with knowledge of computer with MS-CIT. Assistant Research Associate: B.Sc. Agriculture/allied Degree with knowledge of computer with MS-CIT. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of computer with MS-CIT is required for both posts. No accommodation will be provided. Research Associate is a full time worker and must follow the University's administrative, financial and disciplinary regulations.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who cannot produce essential qualification certificates on the date of interview. Candidates arriving after 12.00 pm on the interview day.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Personal interview. Personal interview before Head, Department of Entomology, PGI, Dr. PDKV, Akola. Original certificates are verified by the concerned officer. If there are a large number of candidates, the interview may continue on the next day.
